instruction: Deploy to the staging environment in a job that depends on the test job.
output:
name: deploy-staging
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test
  deploy-staging:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/deploy.sh staging

instruction: Assume an AWS IAM role with GitHub OIDC and sync a static site to S3.
output:
name: aws-oidc-s3
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/github-deploy
          aws-region: us-east-1
      - run: aws s3 sync build/ s3://example-static-site --delete

instruction: Deploy a static site to GitHub Pages with the official Pages actions.
output:
name: github-pages
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ./dist
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

instruction: Log in to Azure with workload identity federation and deploy with the Azure CLI.
output:
name: azure-federated
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

instruction: Authenticate to Google Cloud with workload identity and deploy files to a Cloud Storage bucket.

instruction: Apply Kubernetes manifests to a cluster using a kubeconfig stored as a secret.
output:
name: kubectl-apply
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up kubeconfig
        run: echo "${{ secrets.KUBE_CONFIG }}" | base64 -d > "$HOME/.kube/config"
      - run: kubectl apply -f k8s/ -n production
      - run: kubectl rollout status deployment/webapp -n production --timeout=180s

instruction: Upgrade a Helm chart in the cluster with values from the repository.
output:
name: helm-upgrade
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up kubeconfig
        run: echo "${{ secrets.KUBE_CONFIG }}" | base64 -d > "$HOME/.kube/config"
      - run: helm upgrade --install webapp ./charts/webapp --namespace staging --values ./charts/webapp/values-staging.yaml --wait

instruction: Deploy over SSH by writing a deploy key from secrets and running a remote update script.
output:
name: ssh-remote
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install SSH key
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          echo "${{ secrets.DEPLOY_SSH_KEY }}" > ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
          ssh-keyscan app.example.com >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts
      - run: rsync -az --delete build/ deploy@app.example.com:/srv/www/current/
      - run: ssh deploy@app.example.com 'sudo systemctl restart webapp'

instruction: Publish the deployment URL from a step output and expose it on the environment.
output:
name: env-url-output
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: preview
      url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: deploy
        run: echo "url=https://pr-${{ github.run_number }}.preview.example.com" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

instruction: Deploy to staging and then production as two sequential environment jobs.
output:
name: staging-then-prod
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  staging:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/deploy.sh staging
  production:
    needs: staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

instruction: Deploy a preview build to Vercel with a token secret on every pull request.
output:
name: vercel-preview
on: pull_request
jobs:
  vercel:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci && npm run build
      - name: Deploy preview
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          VERCEL_ORG_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}
        run: npx vercel deploy --token "$VERCEL_TOKEN" --yes

instruction: Deploy a site to Netlify with an auth token and the production branch.
output:
name: netlify
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  netlify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci && npm run build
      - name: Deploy to Netlify
        env:
          NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          NETLIFY_SITE_ID: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}
        run: npx netlify-cli deploy --dir=dist --prod --auth "$NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN" --site "$NETLIFY_SITE_ID"

instruction: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages with wrangler-action.
output:
name: cloudflare-pages
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  pages:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci && npm run build
      - uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          command: pages deploy dist --project-name=webapp

instruction: Update an ECS service after building the image and pushing it with a commit tag.
output:
name: ecs-update
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: us-east-1
      - run: aws ecs update-service --cluster production --service webapp --force-new-deployment
      - run: aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster production --service webapp

instruction: Update a Lambda function package and wait for it to become active.
output:
name: lambda-update
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: cd lambda && zip -r function.zip .
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: us-east-1
      - run: aws lambda update-function-code --function-name processor --zip-file fileb://lambda/function.zip
      - run: aws lambda wait function-updated --function-name processor

instruction: Plan and apply Terraform with OIDC credentials and a non-interactive backend.
output:
name: terraform-apply
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
jobs:
  terraform:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: infra
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_TF_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: us-east-1
      - run: terraform init -input=false
      - run: terraform plan -out=tfplan -input=false
      - run: terraform apply -auto-approve tfplan

instruction: Deploy to several environments with a matrix of environment names.
output:
name: matrix-environments
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Version to deploy
        required: true
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        environment: [dev, staging, production]
      max-parallel: 1
    environment: ${{ matrix.environment }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/deploy.sh ${{ matrix.environment }} ${{ inputs.version }}

instruction: Redeploy the previous known-good version when the health check fails after a deploy.
output:
name: rollback-job
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: deploy
        run: ./scripts/deploy.sh production ${{ github.sha }}
  healthcheck:
    needs: deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: curl -sf https://app.example.com/health
  rollback:
    needs: [deploy, healthcheck]
    if: failure()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/rollback.sh production
